overview_markdown:
CoPaw (recently rebranded as **QwenPaw**) is a personal AI assistant from the AgentScope team, designed to be easy to install and deploy either on your own machine or in the cloud. It emphasizes multi-chat-app support with an extensible capability model, positioning itself as an approachable self-hosted assistant rather than a developer-only framework.

The project is in an active beta stabilization cycle: recent commits focus on e2e test fixes, CI improvements, memory backend restoration, terminal handling, and desktop installer packaging (NSIS). The latest tagged release is v2.2.1, with beta releases (v2.2.2-beta.x) also shipping. Ecosystem digests note steady issue and PR activity, though at a much smaller scale than OpenClaw.

Compared to OpenClaw, CoPaw trades ecosystem size and community momentum for a more curated, org-backed experience with simpler onboarding and desktop distribution. Its Apache-2.0 license and AgentScope/Qwen alignment make it attractive for users in that ecosystem, but the rebrand and beta status introduce some uncertainty for long-term adopters.
